setup_ddp: run distributed data parallel setup by initializing torch.distributed process group with nccl backend
cleanup_ddp: cleanup the distributed process group by destroying initialized torch.distributed processes
set_seed: set random seed for reproducibility across python random, numpy, and torch libraries
get_model_size: get human-readable model parameter count string like 175.0B or 7.1M from a pytorch model
reduce_tensor: reduce a tensor across all distributed processes using sum or average operation
